segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I pulled up the account in the CRM, and I have you at 48 seats today, renewal on March 31st. You mentioned maybe adding the service team?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We'd add 12 seats for service, so 60 total. We want them live by April 15th if we can, just because training starts that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should be fine. On the pricing sheet, moving from 48 to 60 keeps you in the same tier, so it's $82 per seat per month. With the annual prepay discount, the total comes to $59,040 for the year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Is that net of the discount, or before?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net of the discount. List would be $59,040 at monthly, sorry, let me say that correctly. Annual prepay brings it down to $53,136, plus the $3,500 onboarding package for the service workflows.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. And can the invoice be split? Finance asked for software on one line and onboarding on a separate line.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that's easy. I'll note that for the billing tool: one line for subscription, one line for onboarding, both tied to PO 4472 if that's still the right PO.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It is. We just need the start date to be April 1st, even if the service team doesn't start until the 15th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. Term April 1st through March 31st next year, 60 seats, net 30 payment terms. Same MSA as last year, no changes to data processing or support.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Works for me. Send the order form over today and I'll route it for signature. Usually takes two or three business days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send it by 3 p.m. Eastern, and once it's signed, I'll have our onboarding lead reach out to schedule the kickoff for April 3rd or 4th.
